**Summary**  
The GNN model estimates a low risk (0.115) of advanced-stage disease for patient C3N-00150, with 100 % of the predictive signal coming from tumor-protein dysregulation (no recorded phenotypes contribute) [pred:C3N-00150:gnn]. The top tumor drivers are predominantly downregulated proteins—GLB1L, SDC4, AAMP, TJP3, LAD1, MTMR10, VAV2, MYH14, STK33, FNBP1L [contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:79411][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:6385][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:14][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:27134][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:3898][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:54893][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:7410][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:79784][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:65975][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:54874]—many of which map to extracellular-matrix (ECM) organization, cell–cell junctions, and glycosphingolipid/heparan-sulfate degradation pathways.

**Evidence paths**  
- Patient proteomics shows strong downregulation of GLB1L (z=−6.59), AAMP (z=−6.07), MYH14 (z=−6.03), STK33 (z=−8.11), FNBP1L (z=−7.66) [pt:C3N-00150:protein_down:NCBIGene:79411][pt:C3N-00150:protein_down:NCBIGene:14][pt:C3N-00150:protein_down:NCBIGene:79784][pt:C3N-00150:protein_down:NCBIGene:65975][pt:C3N-00150:protein_down:NCBIGene:54874].  
- These same proteins are the highest-weighted tumor_drivers in the GNN prediction [contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:79411][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:14][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:79784][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:65975][contrib:C3N-00150:NCBIGene:54874].

- Upregulated ECM proteins (LOX z=6.79, THBS2 z=6.56, LUM z=6.71, HAPLN3 z=7.74, FLT1 z=6.78) [pt:C3N-00150:protein_up:NCBIGene:4015][pt:C3N-00150:protein_up:NCBIGene:7058][pt:C3N-00150:protein_up:NCBIGene:4060][pt:C3N-00150:protein_up:NCBIGene:145864][pt:C3N-00150:protein_up:NCBIGene:2321] connect to collagen fibril organization, cell adhesion, and VEGF signaling in the subgraph [E3711167][E3656624][E3522506][E342086][E327564].

No curated dismech chains exist for ccRCC (MONDO:0005005) in the knowledge graph. The subgraph implicates coordinated dysregulation of ECM remodeling (LOX, THBS2, LUM, HAPLN3 up; GLB1L, SDC4 down), cell–junction integrity (TJP3 down), and actin‑cytoskeleton dynamics (AAMP, MYH14, FNBP1L down) as the dominant tumor-intrinsic features driving the model’s risk estimate.
